titles.native: ヤドキングのいちにち

description:
It consists of nothing but Pokémon-speak--similar to the mini-movies that air with each theatrical movie. It's a short special based on life of the Pokémon Slowking. It was never released outside of Japan and Greece, due to it only being a few minutes long. But it was officially dubbed in Russian.

(Source: Bulbapedia and Graffitti studio)
